title: AW28 Women's Colour Stories
research_period: AW28/29 colour previews (October 2026), AW27 fairs (September 2026), SS28 previews

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Long-range projection. AW28 fabric fairs take place in September 2027 and the shows in early 2028. This report projects from the first AW28/29 colour forecasts, the AW27 fabric fairs, SS28 previews and long-term market and regulatory drivers. Forecut will update it as evidence arrives.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- "Marinated midtones": honey brown, mustard yellow, turquoise, lime, retro orange and a brown-burgundy, with "pickled fennel" as an anchor colour<sup>[1]</sup>
- Vibrant cobalt with a violet undertone, paired with white; deep wine red with cream and black; bright matcha green with chartreuse and ecru, in menswear and womenswear<sup>[1]</sup>
- Forecut's AW28 projection: ink, mulberry and bottle green over oat and slate, with petrol teal and vermilion as accents<sup>[2]</sup>

sections.heading: Night Blues
sections.body: Ink, slate, petrol teal and oat.

sections.heading: Berry and Gold
sections.body: Mulberry, antique gold, cocoa and oat.

sections.heading: Deep Forest
sections.body: Bottle green, cocoa, oat and vermilion.

sections.heading: Pink Standard
sections.body: Blush to dusty rose with brown.

design_implications: - One capsule or delivery per story.
commercial_implications: - The most neutral story carries volume.
